events.title: Fixed-presentation derivational ranks are not representation-stable; full semantic quotient is hard
formal_statement: On root units x=t=1, the legal B2 alias chain e1<->(x AND t), ei<->(e_{i-1} AND t) makes every ei semantically equivalent to x.

The chosen target ek has an explicit two-Resolution-steps-per-level derivation chain while x is already a root axiom, so selected proof depth/remaining chosen nodes can be inflated without changing the underlying root fact.
A root-only rank avoids alias sensitivity but is unchanged by a pure conservative extension and therefore cannot supply strict extension-step descent by itself.
Exact semantic quotienting of arbitrary B2 circuits is coNP-complete in the general circuit scope, so representation invariance cannot be assumed free.

events.surviving_repair: Merge/quotient proof objects only when a polynomially checkable equivalence or implication certificate is actually present; do not call a semantic equivalence oracle.

events.title: Cook PHP gives a genuine family-specific certified stage rank
formal_statement: Cook's Extended-Resolution PHP proof recursively reduces PHP(m) to PHP(m-1) and has O(n^4) total proof size according to the external construction.
Define mu_PHP(m)=m-1; each certified recursive stage decreases it by exactly one and the base case has rank zero.
Cook's macro x'=a OR (b AND c) has a constant-overhead frozen-B2 realization via t=(b AND c), u=((NOT a) AND (NOT t)), with signed literal NOT u representing x'.
Therefore a cheap exact derivational stage rank exists on this nontrivial structured family without computing shortest-proof distance.

events.external_source: Grosof, Zhang, Heule 2022 modern account of Cook's O(n^4) ER PHP construction; original Cook 1976.
events.claim_ceiling: Family-specific positive control only; does not give a universal CNF rank or solve P vs NP.

active_front.name: U1_G_UNIVERSAL_CERTIFIED_STAGE_DECOMPOSITION
active_front.question: Can arbitrary CNF states be given polynomially constructible proof-carrying reduction stages with a polynomial-range exact rank, generalizing the Cook/PHP pattern without semantic oracle calls or exponential state growth/backtracking?
